import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_96/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_96/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the join on 'fname' and 'day' as specified
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, how='inner', on=['fname', 'day'])

# Group by 'fname' and count occurrences of 'fname' in the joined dataframe
target_df = df_joined.groupby('fname', as_index=False).agg(row_count=('fname', 'count'))

# Ensure the schema matches target: ['fname': string, 'row_count': integer]
target_df['fname'] = target_df['fname'].astype(str)
target_df['row_count'] = target_df['row_count'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_96/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_96/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_96/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Select only the 'fname' column from source0 (it has many columns, but target only needs fname and row_count)
# For source0, each row corresponds to one occurrence of fname
df0 = source0[['fname']]

# For source1, also select 'fname' column
df1 = source1[['fname']]

# UNION the two dataframes (concatenate)
union_df = pd.concat([df0, df1], ignore_index=True)

# Group by 'fname' and count occurrences to get 'row_count'
result = union_df.groupby('fname', as_index=False).agg(row_count=('fname', 'count'))

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_96/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
